question: Who is qualified to investigate this teaching and why are negative attitudes fruitless?
premises: Teachers whose impurities have fallen away and who know the highest and lowest are qualified.
These teachers consist of the true nature of Śiva.
Hatred, fault-finding, loss, and begging are fruitless in this investigation.
inference: Only pure, knowledgeable teachers embodying Śiva's nature are qualified to investigate this teaching, as negative or deficient attitudes yield no fruit.
plain_english: Here, teachers whose impurities have fallen away, who know the highest and the lowest, and who consist of the true nature of Śiva, are qualified for this investigation; because for it, hatred, fault-finding, loss, and begging are fruitless.
